acceptanceCriteria: The target proposal is human-reviewable, links this handoff and both baselines, and contains no unrelated contract change.
avmRequirements: Run the target repository formatting, lint, documentation, examples, test, and AVM pattern-module compliance checks.
compatibilityConstraints: Preserve existing Terraform inputs and outputs; use a reviewed deprecation transition before any removal.
defaultBehavior: Preserve existing Terraform defaults unless a documented migration and semantic-version decision explicitly changes them.
Bicep aiFoundryDisableLocalAuth defaults true; Terraform local_auth_enabled defaults true.
Bicep deployAAfAgentSvc defaults true; Terraform create_ai_agent_service defaults false.
Terraform Foundry BYOR storage defaults ZRS with shared access keys disabled; this is distinct from Terraform standalone GenAI storage.

standalone-network-isolated: Require a separate successful approved test deployment plus reviewed DNS, endpoint, reachability, RBAC, and isolation comparison for this scenario.
standalone-standard: Static checks and plan are non-parity evidence; require a successful approved test deployment and reviewed capability comparison for this scenario.

exclusions: Do not implement hub-spoke or arbitrary optional-feature combinations in this proposal unless separately reviewed.
identityRequirements: Prefer managed identity; preserve inventory identity behavior and do not introduce credentials.
Bicep adds cross-service Foundry, Search, Storage, and Cosmos role assignments needed by configured connections.
Bicep defaults to Entra-only Foundry authentication and assigns project/account roles explicitly.
Bicep prepares project and registry RBAC but does not create the downstream data-plane agent identity/version.
migrationPlan: Document affected consumers, retain deprecated aliases for a transition, and publish upgrade guidance before changing behavior.
networkingRequirements: Preserve scenario-specific public access, private endpoint, DNS, route, subnet, delegation, and dependency-ordering behavior recorded by the inventory.
BYOR resources remain responsible for compatible private connectivity when supplied.
Foundry public access follows networkIsolation and allowedIpRanges in Bicep.
The handoff reports whether private build is required and supplies subnet/jumpbox/agent-pool values.
rbacRequirements: Apply least-privilege RBAC and preserve explicit control-plane and data-plane role boundaries.
Bicep adds cross-service Foundry, Search, Storage, and Cosmos role assignments needed by configured connections.
Bicep defaults to Entra-only Foundry authentication and assigns project/account roles explicitly.
Bicep prepares project and registry RBAC but does not create the downstream data-plane agent identity/version.
requiredBehavior: Foundry account, project, and agent service: Foundry account/project flags, project metadata, agent-service flag, account local-auth posture, and core project outputs.
Foundry models, connections, and BYOR dependencies: Model deployments, Search/Bing/knowledge connections, and existing Search, Storage, and Cosmos dependency IDs including Foundry BYOR storage SKU.

Foundry hosted-agent prerequisites and deployment handoff: Prepare/deploy flags, immutable image digest contract, existing registry contract, role mode, project/registry/network/private-build outputs, and downstream deployment object.

standalone-network-isolated: foundry-account-project-agent: partial - Account and project are supported, but local-auth and agent-service defaults invert Bicep behavior.
foundry-models-connections-byor: partial - Terraform has nested model/connection/BYOR fields but no complete Bicep list contract or automatic cross-service RBAC equivalent.
hosted-agent-handoff: absent - No equivalent hosted-agent immutable deployment handoff, project/registry RBAC preparation, or private-build output exists.
standalone-standard: foundry-account-project-agent: blocked - Terraform Foundry always requests private endpoints and cannot match public standalone. Terraform Foundry create_private_endpoints=true plus mandatory VNet/subnet inputs prevents the standalone-standard Foundry account topology.

foundry-models-connections-byor: blocked - Supported nested Foundry features remain enclosed by mandatory Terraform private topology. Terraform cannot deploy these Foundry nested resources without its structurally required VNet and private endpoints.

hosted-agent-handoff: blocked - No hosted-agent handoff exists and Terraform cannot form the public standard topology. Terraform has no hosted-agent prerequisite/handoff contract and its Foundry resources require the private topology, preventing standalone-standard.

securityInvariants: Do not store secrets, private environment values, or claim effective isolation from static inspection.
